req.title: Update unknown returns 404
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 404 when PUT targets a non-existent task id.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-011 requires PUT /tasks/{task_id} to return HTTP 404 when the task_id does not exist. To achieve high mutation kill rate we need: (1) a positive test confirming a known-existing task (id=1) returns 200 with correct payload fields — this kills mutations that always return 404; (2) a negative test confirming a clearly non-existent id (id=9999) returns exactly 404 — this kills mutations that return 200/400/500 instead; (3) a boundary test at id=21 (one past the last seeded row, max seeded id=20) returning 404 — this kills off-by-one mutations on the existence check; (4) an additional boundary test at id=20 (the last seeded row) returning 200 — this kills mutations that treat the boundary row as non-existent; (5) a negative test at id=0 (below minimum valid id) returning 404 — this kills mutations that short-circuit the not-found path for edge ids. All tests use in-process FastAPI TestClient with an isolated in-memory SQLite database seeded with the canonical 20 rows, exact status-code assertions, and exact JSON field assertions.

tests.name: test_put_existing_task_returns_200_with_payload
preconditions: Task id=1 exists with title='Read chapter 5', completed=true
actions: PUT /tasks/1 with JSON body {"title": "Read chapter 5 updated"}
trace: R-TASK-011: positive path — existing task must NOT return 404
Kills mutations that always raise 404 regardless of task existence
tests.executable:
import os, pytest
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app import models
from app.database import get_db
from datetime import datetime

SEED_ROWS = [
    {"id": 1, "title": "Read chapter 5", "description": "Signal pulse ember", "completed": True, "created_at": datetime(2025,6,1,5,4,17), "updated_at": datetime(2025,6,6,5,4,17)},
    {"id": 20, "title": "Reply to emails", "description": "Summit cascade", "completed": False, "created_at": datetime(2025,5,29,2,8,41), "updated_at": None},
]

def test_put_existing_task_returns_200_with_payload():
    engine = create_engine("sqlite:///:memory:", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
    models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
    Session = sessionmaker(bind=engine)
    db = Session()
    for row in SEED_ROWS:
        db.add(models.Task(**row))
    db.commit(); db.close()
    def override_get_db():
        s = Session()
        try: yield s
        finally: s.close()
    app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.put("/tasks/1", json={"title": "Read chapter 5 updated"})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body["id"] == 1
    assert body["title"] == "Read chapter 5 updated"
    assert body["completed"] == True
    app.dependency_overrides.clear()
